parsed.post: The attempt to increase DEPTH to 12 resulted in a val_bpb of 0.989143, which is worse than my previous best (0.983426). It seems increasing depth too aggressively without adjusting other hyperparameters leads to instability or poor convergence within the 5-minute window. Reverting to DEPTH=8.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=8 and testing a slightly higher learning rate and increased weight decay to find a better balance between capacity and regularization.
